raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly accepted and “confirmed” the director of Poker in Bed as “Giovanni Carnimee” based on a misleading search snippet rather than verifying the correct name, Giuliano Carnimeo (aka Anthony Ascott). This misidentification led to fruitless searches for a non-existent person’s death date and blocked the correct comparison. Correct data show Roberto Rossellini (1977) died earlier than Giuliano Carnimeo (2016), so The Machine to Kill Bad People has the director who died earlier.
